output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_customer_2025
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: This divides 2025 net revenue from completed orders (excluding shipping) by the number of distinct customers with at least one completed order in 2025. Customers whose only 2025 orders were cancelled, returned or still open are not counted as having bought something. The result is in EUR.
